title: JAR
description: A personal project for rendering practice, and for seeing the application of my face scrubber's ergonomics in different forms. With the tapered edge, it is meant to fit any hand shape.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: Rendering practice, and a test of the face scrubber's ergonomics in a different object.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: A clear, rounded body with a tapered edge meant to fit any hand shape.

study_intro: A study in carrying one object's ergonomics into another: the scrubber's hold, reshaped as a jar.

study.label: Form
study.text: A rounded, frosted body with a tapered edge, so any hand finds a grip.

study.label: Material
study.text: Frosted, translucent glass that shows the contents softly, so the food becomes part of the object.

study.label: Lid
study.text: A flat disc with printed rings, reading almost like a dial on top of the sphere.

study.label: Presentation
study.text: Coffee beans orbiting the jar in the renders: the contents are part of the composition.
